## Problem / task

Describe the problem, requested task, scope, and why the change is needed.

## Resulting behavior

Describe the observable behavior after this change, including relevant failure behavior.

## Linked issue or bootstrap record

Closes #

If no issue exists, link the entry in `docs/work-record.md` and explain why.

## Changes made

- 

## Validation and tests

List every command or check run and its result. Include acceptance-criteria evidence and identify unverified integration behavior.

## Known limitations and risks

Describe known risks, deferred work, compatibility concerns, and rollback limitations. Write `None known` when appropriate.

## Documentation and decisions

List documentation and ADR changes, or explain why none were needed.

## Operational impact

Describe migrations, configuration, secrets, permissions, deployment, monitoring, rollout, and rollback. Write `None` when inapplicable.

## Review checklist

- [ ] Work is on a dedicated branch, not `main`.
- [ ] The issue or bootstrap work record is linked.
- [ ] Acceptance criteria and relevant failure paths were checked.
- [ ] Applicable tests, build, lint, and documentation checks pass.
- [ ] Permissions, security, privacy, and audit effects were reviewed.
- [ ] No credentials, tokens, `.env` secrets, or private production data are included.
- [ ] Documentation and ADRs are current.
- [ ] Risks, limitations, and remaining work are stated honestly.
- [ ] The PR is left unmerged for the human repository owner.
